rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Tineke
rows.Origin:
Bred by Herman H. Boerlage (Netherlands, before 1989).
Introduced in Netherlands by Select Roses B.V. in 1989 as 'Tineke'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. None / no fragrance. 50 to 55 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), cupped, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright. Matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 28" to 5' (70 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
